description: Angular component for configuring time series chart line settings in a widget, including form controls, validators, and data binding.

classes.name: TimeSeriesChartLineSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing line settings of a time series chart, implementing ControlValueAccessor for form integration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls and subscriptions for value changes and validators.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form controls with provided value and updates validators.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state and chart type.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: _pointLabelPreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a formatted preview string for point labels based on current data key and widget config.
